title: The PIE investigates: the real cost of non-refundable deposits
summary_en: After UK visa rejection rates soared over the winter, thousands of students from countries like Pakistan and Bangladesh are now being told their tuition fee deposits are non-refundable. The PIE investigates the scale of the problem and how refund policies are being communicated by universities and agents.
author: Nicholas Cuthbert
